text:
Diego R.: Hi 7 I need to remove my mother from my medical and vision plans. She passed away last week. How do I get her removed and is there a way to get a refund for premiums already taken this month?
Lina (People Ops): I'm so sorry for your loss, Diego. :broken_heart: We'll help you through this. For dependent removal due to death we need a scanned death certificate and a short note stating the dependent removal request.
Diego R.: Thanks Lina. Is there a secure place to upload those docs? I don't want to send via email.
people-ops-bot: Secure upload link generated: https://benefits.redwood.com/secure-upload/DR-1855001234 (expires in 14 days).
Lina (People Ops): Use that link and choose "Dependent Removal - Death" in the form. In the notes put the date of death and whether you want coverage terminated retroactive to the date of death or end of current pay period.
Ken L.: From payroll side: we can do retro termination to the date of death and prorate premiums/refunds, but refunds are processed on the next payroll cycle after Benefits confirms the termination. If the premium deduction already hit a past payrun we may issue a manual adjustment on the following cycle.
Diego R.: Okay good to know. Any carrier paperwork I should expect?
Amrita K.: The insurance carriers sometimes require the death certificate directly; we'll submit on your behalf once you upload. If any claims were paid after the date of death there's an extra review but that rarely changes employee refunds. Also, if the dependent was enrolled in our voluntary life policy and listed as a beneficiary, that gets handled separately - we can connect you to the benefits claims specialist.
Diego R.: Do I need to notify benefits within a certain window to avoid issues?
Lina (People Ops): For death it's best to report within 30 days, but we accept documentation beyond that — carriers have their own deadlines. Reporting now is perfect.
people-ops-bot: Case created: PO-6890 7 - Dependent removal (death). Benefits admin notified.
Diego R.: Appreciate it. I'll upload the certificate this afternoon.
Lina (People Ops): We'll take it from there. If you want us to also flag for payroll speedup, say so and tag @Ken.
Diego R.: Please do, thanks.
Ken L.: Got it, I'll watch for the case and coordinate the payroll adjustment.
Amrita K.: Sending my condolences again 614. If you prefer someone to handle the upload for you (family member), we can accept uploads from authorized reps provided you note that in the form and include a short signed authorization.
